doc.title: ZDC–ZNY vCCS LOA
doc.summary: Use of the Virtual Controller Coordination Switch between ZDC and ZNY: CRC chat as primary coordination, vCCS line setup via vccs.app.

items.title: Purpose, cancellation, scope, disclaimer
items.text: Guidance for use of the Virtual Controller Coordination Switch (vCCS) between ZDC and ZNY. Cancels and supersedes the Voice Switching & Communications System LOA dated 16 January 2026. vCCS is not mandatory; controllers who use it follow this standard. Simulation only.

items.title: Primary coordination: CRC chat; vCCS recommended
items.text: The primary method of interfacility coordination is CRC controller-to-controller chat. vCCS is the recommended communication platform and is encouraged when possible.

items.title: vCCS line coordination via vccs.app
items.text: Lines between facilities are coordinated through https://vccs.app: each facility enters the lines requested and the other accepts during profile creation and maintenance. Facility Engineers are primarily responsible for coordinating changes and resolving discrepancies.

items.title: 'vCCS In Use' controller info remark
items.text: Controllers are encouraged to include "vCCS In Use" in their controller information.
